meta.description: Real Bangkok venues near BTS / MRT / Airport Rail Link stations, for Scoop. Venues only — events in scoop-mock-data-bkk.json are still mock.
meta.source: © OpenStreetMap contributors, available under the Open Database License (ODbL). https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright
meta.method: Overpass API queries per category inside 13.65,100.45 – 13.92,100.70; nearest station by straight-line distance; walk_min = distance × 1.3 ÷ 75 m/min. Kept venues within 1 km of a station (1.5 km for workshop, music, comedy), ranked by having a phone, website, Wikidata link and both Thai and English names.
caveats: OpenStreetMap is community-edited: some venues may have moved, closed or changed phone numbers. Check before putting a venue in front of users.
contact_person is always null — public map data has no staff names. Fill it in from venue partners.
comedy mostly means theatres and cabaret: Bangkok has very few dedicated comedy clubs in the data.
workshop is thin in the map data: 10 venues, a few up to ~25 min walk. Worth adding known pottery / cooking studios by hand.
meta.asok_note: v-asok-* added 2026-09-14: Overpass query within 1.3 km of BTS Asok / MRT Sukhumvit, venues not already in this file. category field is the event category used in scoop-mock-data-bkk.json.
meta.google_maps_note: google_maps_url is a Google Maps search link (name + nearest station) for checking each venue by hand; no Google API data is stored.
meta.bulk_note: Venues with added=bulk-500 came from a second OSM pass (2026-09-14): same queries and ranking as scripts/venues, top 60 per category, minus go-go/karaoke/gem-shop names and unnamed night clubs.
